correctness.summary: Direct expansion of the exact rho–gamma boundary parametrization gives a universal quadratic and cubic relation and a symmetric fourth-order phase. The moving branch junction differs from one-half by O(1/N), while the two fourth-order branch polynomials agree at the limiting junction. High-precision evaluations of the exact formulas across both branches converge to the derived coefficient.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The exact rho–gamma region and the auxiliary rho–footrule optimizer are prior work. The claim is restricted to the comonotone endpoint expansion, the explicit fourth-order arithmetic phase, the exact interval of fourth-order subsequential limits, and the resulting absence of a fourth-order Peano coefficient. Searches did not locate these statements. Equivalent endpoint regularity in differently phrased rho–footrule literature remains a residual risk.

value.summary: The result identifies the first order at which the countably accumulating algebraic pieces of the newly solved attainable boundary remain visible: they cancel through cubic order and survive as an exact fourth-order oscillation of width one-half.

limitations: No new global attainable-region characterization is claimed.
The phase is parameterized by theta rather than solely by Gini gamma.
Independent audit has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
